title: Expand Học tập (/levels) into 2-track hub with shared StudyTrackTabs and /modules redirect

spec.problem: Học tập (/levels) is disconnected from practical workplace scenarios (/scenarios) and Japanese NHK news reading (/news), lacks ?track= deep-link redirects, and /modules/[moduleKey] exposes early-preview dev placeholder copy.

acceptance.text: Shared StudyTrackTabs renders 3 navigation links (/{locale}/levels, /{locale}/scenarios, /{locale}/news) with localized labels in vi/en/ja and accurate aria-current=page state at the top of /levels, /scenarios, and /news without duplicating page content or changing the 5-item primary nav.
/[locale]/levels supports ?track= deep links: ?track=scenarios server-redirects to /{locale}/scenarios and ?track=reading server-redirects to /{locale}/news.
/[locale]/modules and /[locale]/modules/[moduleKey] server-redirect to /{locale}/levels without calling daily-radar APIs or showing early-preview dev copy, keeping Strategy (a) files intact.

app/sitemap.ts excludes modules (verified in sitemap.test.ts across vi/ja/en), and updated/new unit tests cover StudyTrackTabs, ?track= redirects, and /modules redirects with §5 justification for modules/[moduleKey]/page.test.tsx; theme-contrast.regression.test.ts and frontend-debt floors stay green untouched.

spec.expected_behavior: Shared StudyTrackTabs renders [Lộ trình BJT | Tình huống công sở | Đọc NHK] across /levels, /scenarios, and /news with accurate active aria-current state and localized labels in vi/en/ja; /levels?track=scenarios redirects to /{locale}/scenarios and /levels?track=reading redirects to /{locale}/news; /modules and /modules/[moduleKey] server-redirect to /{locale}/levels under Strategy (a); sitemap.xml excludes /modules.
spec.observed_behavior: /levels, /scenarios, and /news have no shared hub tab bar; /levels ignores ?track=scenarios and ?track=reading; /modules/[moduleKey] fetches /api/daily-radar/* and renders early-preview placeholder copy while /modules has no redirect page.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert StudyTrackTabs, levels/scenarios/news header mounts, levels ?track= redirects, modules redirects, i18n studyTracks keys, and updated tests.

classification.rationale: Web-only Học tập hub consolidation: adds shared StudyTrackTabs navigation component across /levels, /scenarios, and /news with vi/en/ja i18n keys, adds ?track= deep-link server redirects on /levels, replaces /modules/[moduleKey] (and adds /modules) with server redirects to /{locale}/levels under Strategy (a), and updates modules/[moduleKey]/page.test.tsx per ENGINEERING_POLICY.md §5.
